History of the Hero Rankings.text: The hero rankings began as a way for the public to judge heroes once there were too many to know by name. Magazines and television first ran popularity polls of their own, and arguments over the best hero filled talk shows. The Hero Public Safety Commission replaced the polls with an official chart, the Hero Billboard Chart JP, built on the record: incidents resolved, social contribution and public approval. The chart became the hinge of the hero business, since sponsors, merchandise and big cases follow a high ranking, and agencies began hiring press officers to manage their image. Critics have long argued that counting approval rewards heroes who chase cameras, and the debate returns whenever a popular hero fumbles a case.
